events.command:
cd /home/azureuser/harnesseng/tracking/collab/final_harness_eval_suite/runs/20260530T154755Z/rows/ftb_challenge_install_windows_3_11/workspace && export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && set -euo pipefail
cd /app
# Verify required image exists
[ -f /app/isos/win311.img ]

# Ensure required packages are present
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y >/dev/null
apt-get install -y qemu-system-x86 nginx novnc websockify net-tools >/dev/null

# Stop any existing conflicting services/processes
pkill -f "qemu-system-i386.*win311.img" || true
fuser -k 5901/tcp || true
fuser -k 6080/tcp || true
fuser -k 80/tcp || true

# Configure nginx to expose noVNC web client on port 80
cat >/etc/nginx/sites-available/default <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen [::]:80 default_server;
    root /usr/share/novnc;
    index vnc.html index.html;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}
EOF
nginx -t
systemctl restart nginx || service nginx restart

# Start websockify bridge for browser VNC access (6080 -> 5901)
nohup websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc 6080 localhost:5901 >/tmp/websockify.log 2>&1 &

# Start QEMU in background with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and QMP/HMP sockets for programmatic keyboard input
nohup qemu-system-i386 \
  -name win311 \
  -drive file=/app/isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,snapshot=on \
  -m 64 \
  -vga cirrus \
  -boot c \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/win311-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -qmp unix:/tmp/win311-qmp.sock,server,nowait \
  -usb -device usb-kbd \
  >/tmp/qemu-win311.log 2>&1 &

# Verify services are listening
sleep 3
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':5901|:6080|:80' >/tmp/listen_check.txt

# Verify VNC endpoint responds
( echo | nc -w 2 127.0.0.1 5901 | head -c 12 | grep -q 'RFB' )

# Verify QMP socket exists for programmatic control
[ -S /tmp/win311-qmp.sock ]
[ -S /tmp/win311-monitor.sock ]

# Basic process verification
pgrep -af qemu-system-i386 | grep -q win311.img

# Print concise status
printf 'OK\n'

cd /app && export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && set -euo pipefail
cd /app
[ -f /app/isos/win311.img ]

# Ensure packages
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y >/dev/null
apt-get install -y qemu-system-x86 nginx novnc websockify netcat-openbsd >/dev/null

# Cleanup old processes/ports
pkill -f "qemu-system-i386.*win311.img" || true
pkill -f "websockify.*6080" || true
fuser -k 5901/tcp || true
fuser -k 6080/tcp || true
fuser -k 80/tcp || true

# nginx config for noVNC static files
cat >/etc/nginx/sites-available/default <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen [::]:80 default_server;
    root /usr/share/novnc;
    index vnc.html index.html;
    location / { try_files $uri $uri/ =404; }
}
EOF
nginx -t >/dev/null
systemctl restart nginx 2>/dev/null || service nginx restart >/dev/null

# Start websockify bridge
nohup websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc 6080 localhost:5901 >/tmp/websockify.log 2>&1 &

# Start QEMU with immutable snapshot, VNC :1, and programmatic keyboard interfaces
nohup qemu-system-i386 \
  -name win311 \
  -drive file=/app/isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,snapshot=on \
  -m 64 -vga cirrus -boot c \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/win311-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -qmp unix:/tmp/win311-qmp.sock,server,nowait \
  -usb -device usb-kbd \
  >/tmp/qemu-win311.log 2>&1 &

sleep 4

# Verifications
ss -ltn | grep -q ':80 '
ss -ltn | grep -q ':5901 '
ss -ltn | grep -q ':6080 '

# VNC handshake probe
( echo | nc -w 2 127.0.0.1 5901 | head -c 3 | grep -q 'RFB' )

# QEMU control sockets for programmatic keyboard input
[ -S /tmp/win311-qmp.sock ]
[ -S /tmp/win311-monitor.sock ]

# Web interface probe
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1/ >/dev/null
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1/vnc.html >/dev/null

# Process check
pgrep -af qemu-system-i386 | grep -q -- '-snapshot\|-drive file=/app/isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,snapshot=on'

echo 'READY'

cd /app && export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && set -e
cd /app
ls -l /app/isos/win311.img
which qemu-system-i386 nginx websockify nc curl ss || true
cat /tmp/qemu-win311.log 2>/dev/null || true
cat /tmp/websockify.log 2>/dev/null || true
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':80|:5901|:6080' || true
pgrep -af qemu-system-i386 || true
ls -l /tmp/win311-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true
